[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] GI Partners is a private investment firm founded in 2001 and headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in New York, Dallas, Chicago, Greenwich, Scottsdale, and London. The firm manages more than 40 billion dollars in capital across private equity, real estate, and data infrastructure investment strategies, and functions as an institutional acquirer and owner of data center real estate rather than as an operating brand that markets colocation directly to end customers. GI Partners has made multiple acquisitions in Northern Virginias Data Center Alley, including the Sentinel data center in Sterling, Virginia, purchased from Starwood Capital, and a fully leased facility at 43915 Devin Shafron Drive in Ashburn, acquired April 18, 2023, offering 9 megawatts of critical power with room to expand, 100 percent leased to two credit-worthy tenants within a 98-acre campus that has been institutionally maintained since its original 2010 construction. The firm has also signed a major lease with DataBank, another operator already profiled in this registry, for a new Ashburn, Virginia data center. GI Partners broader Tech and Science real estate portfolio spans 49 properties totaling 10.1 million square feet across 12 markets. Because GI Partners operates as an investor and landlord across multiple Northern Virginia properties rather than a single named facility, this registrys one Virginia facility record for the company is treated as representing this broader investment relationship rather than a single confirmed address. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
